issues.description: The problem statement and UML require Farm.animals to be a List<Animal> (specifically an ArrayList initialized in the no-arg constructor), but the solution implements the animals attribute as a Queue<Animal> backed by a LinkedList. This mismatch between the specified collection type and the solution's type can confuse students (they are explicitly instructed to use ArrayList/List) and may cause tests or grading scripts that expect a List/ArrayList to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the implementation with the specification: declare the animals field as List<Animal> and initialize it with new ArrayList<>() in the no-argument constructor. Update getter/setter and addAnimal/feedAllAnimals/singFarmSong to use List methods (e.g., add and iterate). Alternatively, update the problem statement to accept a Queue/LinkedList if that was intentional, but preferably follow the current instructions to use ArrayList/List.
